Method of Attack: Exploitation of Apache Log4j vulnerability (Log4Shell) to execute a Java class from an attacker-controlled remote server
Java class downloads and launches an HTA file to install Dridex on Windows devices
If Windows commands fail, downloads and executes a Python script to install Meterpreter on Linux/Unix devices
Dridex acts as a loader downloading modules for malicious behaviors including installing payloads, spreading, taking screenshots
Meterpreter provides a remote shell for executing commands and deploying further payloads or ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: HTA file downloaded and executed on Windows
VBS file created in C:\ProgramData folder acting as Dridex downloader
'm.py' Python script executed on Linux devices
